rationale: M49 W15 #814 (owner ruling: converge the family on METHOD source). The java analyzer sourced `this`/`super` field reads to the enclosing TYPE — the JAD2 exception, whose stated justification was the swift precedent, while every other receiver already resolved to the enclosing method. The ruling moved javascript/java/swift onto method-source (python/dart/cpp already agreed), so a member read is attributed to the method that performs it and `x calls read` + `read uses count` composes into reachability. `bump()` pins the JAD1 write gate in the same fixture: an assignment LHS is a write and must emit no uses edge at all — the old contract could not distinguish these two directions because both collapsed onto the type-sourced pair.

expectRelationships.note: #814: source = the enclosing METHOD. Pre-ruling this edge was `Store -> count`, indistinguishable from the JAD1 write spelling below

forbidRelationships.note: #814: the TYPE-sourced spelling is now the DEFECT spelling (mutant java/type-source-revert produces exactly this)
JAD1: `this.count = 1` is a write, never a read
